{{Quote|Look, Captain Zornak! Our probe has found it&hellip; the ''Ewok village!"<br />"''<nowiki />''Excellent!''<nowiki />|Zornak's companion and Zornak|<ref name="E14" />}}
A '''companion''' traveled with the [[Zornak's species|alien]] [[Zornak]] to the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The alien assisted Zornak in rounding up the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] against their will, forcing them to gather [[Gemstone/Legends|gems]] for Zornak. However, one remaining [[Teebo/Legends|Ewok]] was able to escape and use Zornak's [[stones of obedience]] against him, forcing him to leave Endor.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Soon we shall have a full load of precious gems, Captain!|Zornak's companion|<ref name="E14" />}}
The companion of the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zornak]] was a member of the same [[Zornak's species|species]] as Zornak.<ref name="E14" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{InsiderCite|23|Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline}} dates the events of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which include the events of [[Ewoks (1985) 14|''Ewoks'' 14]], to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the two traveled to the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] with a [[Zornak's spaceship|starship]], intending on [[Slavery/Legends|enslaving]] the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]. They used a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] to locate the Ewok [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|village]], which Zornak then teleported to using a [[transport chamber]] that his companion had prepared. Prior to Zornak's departure, the two excitedly discussed what they would be able to do with the Ewoks under their control.<ref name="E14" />

[[File:ZornakWicket.jpg|thumb|right|270px|Zornak (right) and his companion (left) give orders to Wicket Warrick.]]
Once Zornak had used the [[stones of obedience]] to put the Ewoks under his control, he and the crewmate oversaw them loading up precious [[Gemstone/Legends|gems]] into their [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. However, their probe [[Droid/Legends|droid]] discovered that one Ewok, [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], had not been given a stone of obedience and was therefore free of their control. Zornak's companion pointed him out and offered to chase Teebo after he escaped back into the [[Forest/Legends|forests]], but Zornak mentioned that they were too dense; he felt it would be better to send an Ewok after him instead, choosing [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]] for the task.<ref name="E14" />

After Zornak gave his companion's [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster]] to Warrick and ordered him to [[Stun/Legends|stun]] and capture Teebo, Warrick entered the forest to search for him. The runaway Ewok was able to break Warrick free of the stone, however, allowing Teebo to devise a plan that resulted in him using a stone of obedience against Zornak. Once the alien was under his control, Warrick had him issue an order to the rest of the crew to free all of the Ewoks and leave the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of Endor. Shortly after Zornak gave the command, the starship lifted off and left.<ref name="E14" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Shall I ''pursue'' him?|Zornak's companion, regarding Teebo|<ref name="E14" />}}
Zornak's companion was excited at the prospect of having lots of precious gems. The alien had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and green skin.<ref name="E14" />

==Equipment==
The companion wore pink [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] along with blue [[Boot/Legends|boots]] and blue [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], gold-colored sleeves, as well as a gold-colored sash and [[Belt/Legends|belt]]. The alien also wore a blue [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] that had two white horns protruding from its top and utilized a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] that had a stun setting.<ref name="E14" />

==Behind the scenes==
The companion of Zornak appeared in the [[Ewoks (1985) 14|fourteenth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which was written by [[David Manak]], illustrated by [[Warren Kremer]], and published by [[Marvel Comics]]<ref name="E14" /> on [[March 31]], [[1987]].<ref name="MarvelAge">{{BookCite|title=[[Marvel Age]]|number=Vol. 1 No. 51|publisher=[[Marvel Comics]] Group|date=[[June]] [[1987]]|issn=8750-4367}}</ref>
